angles: Define the target as the complement of the baseline's own distribution: use the single strong agent (same model, same brief) as a reference likelihood model and have the system spend its generation, critique and selection budget only on ideas the baseline would be unlikely to produce or to self-select but that still survive critique, since ideas inside the baseline's mode can at best tie it.

Attribute the gain by stage using crossover arms before optimizing anything: run the system's selector on the baseline's 20-idea pool and the baseline's self-selection on the system's pool (and swap development on or off), so each pipeline stage's lift over the baseline is measured separately, and then put the redesign effort into the stage whose crossover shows the baseline wins or ties.

domains.text: Immunology: germinal-center affinity maturation, where B-cell clones mutate and must compete for scarce T-follicular-helper signals, so selection pressure comes from rationed help that only the best binders obtain, repeated over cycles, rather than from a single scoring pass.

Sensory science and food panel testing: triangle and duo-trio discrimination tests that first establish whether trained tasters can reliably tell two samples apart at all, before any preference is asked, and that use palate cleansing and randomized serving order to separate real differences from presentation effects.
